name: Workplace Conversation Prep
description: Prepares the user for a difficult workplace conversation by scripting the opening statement, anticipated responses with branching dialogue, and de-escalation moves. Covers feedback delivery, conflict resolution, boundary setting, and saying no to scope creep. Produces a conversation script with branches. Use when the user needs to have a difficult conversation at work, deliver tough feedback, resolve a conflict with a colleague, set boundaries, or push back on unreasonable requests. Do NOT use for salary negotiation (use salary-negotiation-script), performance review preparation (use performance-review-prep), or mentorship outreach (use mentorship-outreach).
